_comment: The preview engine's copy table (ROADMAP/GROWTH B45, plan ~/projects/plans/19-preview-sites.md). One row per category in client-leads/scripts/services.json, so a preview is filled without a model call: `leads preview` reads this, never invents a service a business didn't say it does. GROWTH § 15.2 #3 reuses the same table to build a client's site at activation. Keys: template (templates/sites/<type>), trade (what to call them in a sentence), tagline (under the name; {city} is the listing's city), intro (one line of About; {name}, {city}), services (four to six lines the category implies, each a heading + a plain line), hero (the img stock search term), cta (the button word). Every services line must be something the category itself means, not a claim about this business: a plumber's list says 'Drain and sewer' because plumbers do drains, and the page says 'what a <trade> is usually asked for' above it, never 'our services'.
